mechanism: Piperacillin can inactivate gentamicin in vitro and in vivo through beta-lactam ring opening, reducing aminoglycoside efficacy; additionally, both drugs increase nephrotoxicity and ototoxicity risk.
action: Monitor serum creatinine and aminoglycoside levels closely; ensure adequate hydration; consider alternative beta-lactam if possible; space administration if feasible to minimize inactivation.
